title: Surreal Porhole Dreamscape
description: A circular porthole-like frame with rivets, keys, barnacles and paint splatters contains a surreal night scene. Inside, a cracked moon floats above a dark sea with illuminated carnival ships, a Ferris wheel, a haunted house boat, endless rows of purple theater seats leading to a tall dripping green candle with a flame.
prompt: Surreal circular porthole frame covered in barnacles, keys, rivets and paint splatters, looking out into a dark sea at sunset. A cracked moon hangs in the sky above illuminated carnival ships with string lights, a haunted house boat, a Ferris wheel, and endless rows of purple theater seats leading toward a giant melting green candle with a bright flame. Dreamlike and eerie atmosphere.
